{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Tuxpan V power station''' (Central CC Tuxpan V) is an operating power station of at least 495-megawatts (MW) in Tuxpan de Rodríguez Cano, Veracruz, Mexico.
It is also known as Electricidad Sol de Tuxpan.
